data:
description: 8 chars from ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789.
              example: { code: "K7WQ2MZP" }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ProofRefused' }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Busy' }

  /api/pair/redeem:
    post:
      tags: [pairing]
      operationId: pairRedeem
      summary: Redeem a pairing code for a Bearer token
      description: |
        Called from the mobile app with the code shown in the browser. No session
        required: the code *is* the credential (one-shot, 5-minute TTL). Returns the
        same HMAC-signed session token the cookie would carry; the app sends it as
        `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from then on. CSRF-exempt.
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [code]
              properties:
                code:
                  type: string
                  description: The pairing code (case-insensitive).
            example: { code: "K7WQ2MZP" }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paired.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  token:
                    type: string
                    description: Signed session token, valid for SESSION_DAYS.
                  user: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionUser' }
        '400':
          description: >-
            Code unknown, already used, expired, or the account behind it is gone or
            disabled (deliberately the same message for all of these).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
              example: { error: "invalid or expired code", code: "pair-invalid" }

  /api/watch/pair:
    post:
      tags: [watch]
      operationId: watchPair
      summary: A pairing code for a Zepp OS watch
      description: |
        A signed-in device asks for a code that the Zepp app's settings page for openGym
        redeems (`POST /api/watch/redeem`). 12 characters typed as `XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`, one per
        profile (a new one replaces the last), good for ten minutes, held only as a hash.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The code and when it expires (ms since the epoch).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code: { type: string }
                  exp: { type: integer }
              example: { code: "K7WQ-2MZP-8RTA", exp: 1761743400000 }
